purpose.en: Practise controlled alternating hip internal rotation while sitting with the hands supported behind the body.

text.zh: 手在身后撑地，一侧膝盖向内倒
text.en: Hands behind you, drop one knee inward

text.zh: 屈膝宽站脚，双手在身后稳定撑垫
text.en: Sit with bent knees and feet wide, keeping the hands supported steadily behind you.

text.zh: 先让右膝向内缓慢下落，双脚保持踩稳
text.en: Lower the right knee inwards slowly first while both feet stay planted.

text.zh: 回到中间再换左侧，不强压膝盖或翻动骨盆
text.en: Return through the centre before changing left without pushing the knee down or rolling the pelvis.

commonErrors.zh: 手脚滑动、肩膀塌陷，靠移动脚来躲开髋内旋
commonErrors.en: Letting the hands or feet slide, collapsing the shoulders or moving a foot to avoid hip internal rotation.

commonErrors.zh: 用手压膝盖、突然倒膝或强扭膝踝
commonErrors.en: Pressing the knee down by hand, dropping suddenly or twisting the knee or ankle forcefully.

items.zh: 膝踝与髋：膝盖向内的幅度以舒适为限，不对固定脚强行扭转。
items.en: Knees, ankles and hips: use a comfortable inward knee range without forcing rotation over a planted foot.

items.zh: 手腕与肩：后撑保持稳定，躯干后倾以能舒适承托为限。
items.en: Wrists and shoulders: keep the rear support stable and lean back only as far as you can support comfortably.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制手掌负重、肩部后伸、髋内旋或膝踝旋转时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if palm weight bearing, shoulder extension, hip internal rotation or knee or ankle rotation has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: The 8-second source shows one right-knee drop/return followed by one left-knee drop/return; each peak lasts only 1 second. Preserve the legacy 30-second-per-side static-hold prescription as an unresolved requirement. Alternating dynamic loops must not be represented as a continuous 30-second hold. Editorial and playback reconciliation remain pending.
definition.movementSides: Right knee drops inward first with the right foot planted; the left knee follows after 4 seconds. Both hands remain supporting behind the hips.
editorialNotes: 旧审核明确每侧30秒static hold，数值及每侧处方保留；源实际右左交替，每侧仅1秒plateau且4秒换侧。不得把循环示范写成已执行每侧30秒静态保持；需要编辑/播放裁决，继续pending。
新wrapper保留h0求解、左右手脚floor锁和arm reach176；掌面厚度问题应由后续独立修订解决，不能改free丢锁。
h-reverse-clam为同髋内旋目标但主动/侧卧支撑不同的替代候选；h-9090-liftoff为90/90主动末端控制候选进阶，非等价静态hold处方。独立同模式降阶未核定。
相位来自catalog/v2/batches/b003.json真实源时间；剂量数字与范围保持旧catalog。rhythm只描述动画，不使用旧reps或holdSeconds来覆盖处方。
具体双语注意、通用禁用筛查、协同肌群与关系均为待审草稿；协同包含稳定/次要拉伸角色，不是额外高亮或肌电激活结论。
关系均为本仓库真实ID候选，不等于已有同模型可发布v2包；不得自动回退弃用模型素材。空关系缺口见逐动作说明。
通用医学筛查证据边界沿用catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md的AAOS/NHS一手资料；不编造疾病特异绝对禁忌，编辑/医学审核均保持pending。

switchPoint.semantics: Right knee drops inward first with the right foot planted; the left knee follows after 4 seconds. Both hands remain supporting behind the hips. The 8-second source shows one right-knee drop/return followed by one left-knee drop/return; each peak lasts only 1 second. Preserve the legacy 30-second-per-side static-hold prescription as an unresolved requirement. Alternating dynamic loops must not be represented as a continuous 30-second hold. Editorial and playback reconciliation remain pending.
